blocks.text: 最有帮助的搜索体验，既汇聚了世界上丰富的信息，也融合了与你独特相关的洞察。如今，搜索变得更加个性化：你可以把更多应用接入个人智能，我们也在推出更多与你个人相关的回答，让你更容易找到真正需要的内容。

inlines.text: 最有帮助的搜索体验，既汇聚了世界上丰富的信息，也融合了与你独特相关的洞察。如今，搜索变得更加个性化：你可以把更多应用接入个人智能，我们也在推出更多与你个人相关的回答，让你更容易找到真正需要的内容。

blocks.text: 从今天开始逐步推送：你可以选择在AI 模式中安全地将 Google Wallet 接入个人智能，Drive 和 Gemini 应用的支持将在未来几周内跟进——把你的消费、文档和聊天中的上下文直接带入搜索。这些应用将与 Gmail、日历和相册一起，结合你的个人上下文，提供更加贴合你的回答。

用 Google Wallet 更清楚地了解你的消费：
在 AI 模式和
Gemini 应用
中把 Google Wallet 接入个人智能后，你可以梳理自己的财务里程碑，并找出切实可行的日常省钱方法。你还可以根据通过 Wallet 关联的信用卡，最大化信用卡权益——比如优化返现类别、旅行福利和奖励积分。如果你选择接入 Wallet，AI 模式只能读取你账户中的信息，不能转移、管理或投资你的资金。
用 Google Drive 保持工作节奏：
有时，启动一个项目或做出重大决定所需的重要信息，会分散在你的文档、表格或 PDF 中。在个人智能中接入 Google Drive 后，你可以获得充分考虑这些上下文的独特帮助，比如在报税季到来前获得一份个性化的准备计划。
打通 Gemini 应用与搜索：
未来几周，你可以轻松地在 Gemini 应用和搜索中的 AI 模式之间共享上下文。这样，如果你在 Gemini 应用中探索了一个想法，AI 模式就能以此为基础继续推进，反之亦然。此前你已经可以选择将
搜索历史记录
接入 Gemini 应用中的个人智能，很快你还可以选择在 AI 模式中安全地将 Gemini 应用接入个人智能。

blocks.text: 要在 AI 模式中将应用接入个人智能，请打开搜索个性化，选择已连接的应用，然后选择你想要连接的应用。是否接入以及何时接入由你决定，你也可以随时开启或关闭这些连接。个性化设置始终由你掌控，很快你还可以通过任何个性化回答下方的“个性化”图标，查看 AI 模式使用了哪些上下文。如果你想修改任何内容，只需告诉 AI 模式要改什么，比如在对话中回复“我不再是素食者了”。

blocks.text: The most helpful search experience brings together the richness of the world’s information with insights uniquely relevant to you. Today, Search is getting even more tailored with the ability to connect more of your apps to Personal Intelligence — and we're introducing more personally relevant responses, so it's easier to find just what you need.

inlines.text: The most helpful search experience brings together the richness of the world’s information with insights uniquely relevant to you. Today, Search is getting even more tailored with the ability to connect more of your apps to Personal Intelligence — and we're introducing more personally relevant responses, so it's easier to find just what you need.

blocks.text: Starting to roll out today, you can opt in to securely connect Google Wallet to Personal Intelligence in AI Mode, with support for Drive and the Gemini app following in the coming weeks — bringing context from your spending, documents, and chats directly to Search. These apps join Gmail, Calendar, and Photos in delivering even more tailored responses with your personal context.

Personal Intelligence
in
AI Mode

, with support for Drive and the Gemini app following in the coming weeks — bringing context from your spending, documents, and chats directly to Search. These apps join Gmail, Calendar, and Photos in delivering even more tailored responses with your personal context.
Get a clearer picture of your spending with Google Wallet:
By connecting Google Wallet to Personal Intelligence in both AI Mode and the
Gemini app

, you can map out your financial milestones and identify actionable ways to trim everyday spending. You can also maximize credit card benefits — like optimizing cash-back categories, travel perks, and reward points — based on your cards linked via Wallet. If you choose to connect your Wallet, AI Mode can only read information from your accounts; it can’t move, manage, or invest your money.
Stay in your flow with Google Drive:

Sometimes the important information that you need to get started on a project or make a big decision can be scattered across your docs, sheets, or PDFs. With Google Drive connected in Personal Intelligence, you can get uniquely helpful responses that take all of that context into account and help you get started, like a personalized preparation plan ahead of tax season.
Connect the dots between the Gemini app and Search:

In the coming weeks you can easily share context across the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search. So if you explore an idea in the Gemini app, AI Mode will have that foundation to build on, and vice versa. While you could already opt in to
connect your Search history
to Personal Intelligence in the Gemini app, soon you can also opt in to securely connect your Gemini app to Personal Intelligence in AI Mode.

blocks.text: To connect your apps to Personal Intelligence in AI Mode, open Search Personalization, select Connected Apps, and then choose the apps you want to connect. You choose if and when you opt in, and you can turn those connections on or off at any time. You’re always in control of your personalization settings, and soon you’ll also be able to view the context AI Mode uses via the “Personalization” icon below any tailored response. If you want to edit anything simply let AI Mode know what to change, like responding in thread “I’m no longer a vegetarian.”

blocks.text: You’ll also start seeing more personally relevant responses in AI Overviews and AI Mode, tailored to your recent search context. So if you’ve been researching and planning for a trip, you can pick up right where you left off in a new search thread without starting over or repeating yourself. As always, you can adjust or turn off personalization at any time in your Search Settings.
